instructions: Review Doomberg changes as an agent-native market research and paper-trading control plane. Prioritize tenant isolation, scoped MCP/API-key behavior, installer idempotency, secret handling, and tests that prove user-facing setup paths. Do not request generic refactors unless they reduce a concrete correctness or security risk.

rules.rule: Installer changes must not overwrite existing user MCP servers or leak API keys into tracked files.
Hosted MCP access must stay tenant-scoped and bearer-token based; browser UI flows must not bypass scoped key issuance.
Frontend changes should remove filler copy and preserve a direct dashboard/docs/setup flow.
